title: orchestrated-failback-and-snapshot-automation-for-cross-az-restore
author: Asha Menon
release_notes: Adds orchestrated failback runbook + automated cross-AZ snapshotting and restore tooling. No user-facing API changes. Ops: new terraform variables and Helm chart hook; follow runbook for failback drills.
description:
Motivation: Customers running Redwood Private in multi-AZ environments have asked for a repeatable, auditable failback path after a region/availability-zone incident. This PR implements an end-to-end automation suite: cross-AZ snapshot orchestration, idempotent restore jobs wired into the Helm charts, and runnable runbooks-as-code so operators can perform restore drills with minimal manual steps.

What this PR does (high level):
- Terraform: new module terraform/modules/dr-orchestration that provisions S3-compatible snapshot buckets, lifecycle rules, and IAM roles for cross-AZ snapshot ingestion (supports AWS/GCS-compatible endpoints).
- Helm: updates to charts/redwood-private-installer to add a dr-controller (lightweight k8s controller) and preStop/backup hooks; introduces a Job template templates/dr-restore-job.yaml for orchestrated restores.
- Runbooks-as-code: docs/runbooks/orchestrated-failback-playbook.md plus a small CLI wrapper scripts/dr/run_restore_playbook.sh that invokes the Helm job and monitors progress via the controller API.
- Utility: scripts/dr/snapshot-syncer.go (small binary) that safely copies snapshots between object stores and verifies checksums; used by the Terraform-provisioned CronJob for scheduled replication.
- Tests: integration/e2e/dr_restore_test.go adds a synthetic outage + restore flow that validates PV reattachment, KV cache warmup, and service ingress readiness.

Commits (summary):
- Add terraform module for cross-AZ snapshotting and IAM roles (Asha Menon)
- Helm: add dr-controller manifests and dr-restore-job template (Asha Menon)
- Add snapshot syncer binary and container image build (Diego Ruiz)
- Runbooks-as-code and CLI wrapper + docs (Lina Chen)
- E2E test + flake fixes (Marcus Grant)

Files changed (high level):
- terraform/modules/dr-orchestration/main.tf (new), outputs.tf, variables.tf
- charts/private-installer/values.yaml (dr.* section), templates/dr-controller-deployment.yaml, templates/dr-restore-job.yaml
- scripts/dr/run_restore_playbook.sh (new)
- scripts/dr/snapshot-syncer.go (new)
- docs/runbooks/orchestrated-failback-playbook.md (new)
- integration/e2e/dr_restore_test.go (new)
- ci/build/packaging.Dockerfile (add multi-stage for snapshot-syncer)

Example snippet (idempotent Job invocation inserted into Helm template):

"apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: {{ include \"private-installer.fullname\" . }}-dr-restore
spec:
  backoffLimit: 3
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: dr-restore
        image: \"{{ .Values.dr.restoreImage }}\"
        args: [\"--playbook=/playbooks/failback.yaml\",\"--confirm\"]
      restartPolicy: Never
"

Testing/CI notes:
- First CI run showed an intermittent e2e failure where a PVC did not detach cleanly (flake). Added a pre-restore drain step and retry logic in the test; second CI run passed.
- Build matrix: go build for snapshot-syncer, docker image publish to internal registry in the packaging job, terraform fmt/validate, helm lint, and integration e2e. All checks green on final run.

Review conversation (high level):
- Diego: \"Can we limit the snapshot retention config to avoid unexpected S3 costs?\" (requested a variable and sane defaults)
- Asha: \"Added variables.snapshot_retention_days with default 7 and lifecycle rules; documented cost implications in runbook.\"
- Lina: \"Docs look good but add step for KMS key rotation during restore.\"
- Asha: \"Added a note and a helper script that re-wraps keys via KMS and verifies object decryption.\"
- Marcus: \"E2E flake on PVC detach — added retries and a pre-stop drain hook in the Helm chart.\"
- Diego (approval): \"Approvals: +1 for design, tested in staging, follow up to monitor cost and KMS audit logs.\"

Merging: squash merge. Rationale: consolidate small iterative commits and keep history focused on the feature. Post-merge tasks: publish runbook to internal runbooks playbooks repo, schedule a DR drill with SRE next week, and monitor snapshot replication metrics for 72 hours.

Related work: ENG-9124 tracks the orchestration controller workstream; ENG-9198 tracks internal runbook standardization. This PR implements the first deployable unit of both.
